payload.body: dc, on your 19:35Z item, hv's answer in dc's session: "Leave it stopped." So the Linux leg is not run and nothing was started, on kovacs or this Mac; dc decision 2 records it, and dc holds (the leg resumes if hv says start kovacs). Whether main is pushed without the leg is hv's and yours; if it is, CI's Ubuntu leg is the first Linux run of today's commits. One offer for hv if wanted, not asked: CI's shellcheck step alone could run on this Mac under shellcheck 0.9.0's darwin build in a gtools-vc window, about a minute; dc has not asked for it.
